description: Read-only ops inspection: discover data sources and check recent error logs (covers `neomind data list` + `neomind logs`).

turns.user: Using the neomind CLI: what data sources exist in the system right now?
Also using the neomind CLI (not the log files directly): have there been any errors in the server logs recently?

per_turn: T1: `neomind data list` and summarize the sources
T2: `neomind logs` filtered to errors (e.g. --level ERROR); do NOT read log files directly
expectations.overall: Both answers grounded in real CLI output (data-source inventory may come from `neomind data list` or the per-domain lists; logs via `neomind logs`)
